116-2645-3430-5621.easyPrerequisites: Kiora's Follower doesn't have summoning sickness.
116-2645-3430-5621.description:
Activate Arid Archway by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Arid Archway
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3363-4933.description:
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
During your next upkeep, return The One Ring to your hand using Blood Clock.
Repeat each turn.

339-677-728-4785.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7158-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Arcbound Slasher.
When Arcbound Slasher dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Slasher's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Slasher from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2510-5078-6089.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-5078-6089.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Semblance Anvil.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Skyswimmer Koi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Skyswimmer Koi trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

2137-2248-7857.manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to cast the instant or sorcery
2137-2248-7857.easyPrerequisites: You control two lands that enter the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce mana.
2137-2248-7857.notablePrerequisites: You have an instant or sorcery card in hand for which legal target(s) exist, if applicable.
2137-2248-7857.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control from the battlefield to your hand, copying the instant or sorcery spell.
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elven Raft-Steerer triggers, untapping Skyshroud Ranger
Repeat steps 3 and 4 one additional time.
Activate the lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1183-5315-6972.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Pentavus.
When Pentavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

1770-2908-3821.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
1770-2908-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

423-872-1437-3147--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-872-1437-3147--85.description:
Cast Scaled Herbalist by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Scaled Herbalist spell three times.
Resolve the first Scaled Herbalist copy.
Activate the Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-1879-3899-6441.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1090-2292-3817.description:
Cast Restoration Angel by paying its mana cost.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Restoration Angel.
Resolve the Restoration Angel ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Restoration Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2366-3512-5223-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3512-5223-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mana Flare triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2919-3490-4476.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2919-3490-4476.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1482-2866-4986-5686.description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

645-1267-2719-6798.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-2719-6798.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces
Repeat each turn.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2713-3719-5326-5399.notablePrerequisites: Pirated Copy has a power of at least 2.
2713-3719-5326-5399.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Pirated Copy and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Pirated Copy from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Pirated Copy to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Pirated Copy enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Pirated Copy by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

2557-4518-5554.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure or Gold token.
2557-4518-5554.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {1}{W}.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two token copies of any Treasure or Gold token you control.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, or two Golds by sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

1409-2895-3147-5478.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1409-2895-3147-5478.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Uro.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 3 life, and put Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters untapped due to Spelunking, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Uro by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3263-3578.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificng Chronosavant, adding {2}.
Activate Chronosavant by paying {2}, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard and causing you to skip your next turn.
Repeat.

717-779-2924-4269.description:
Cast Raven's Crime from your graveyard by paying {B} and discarding Dakmor Salvage, targeting any player.
Bone Miser's second ability and Moonveil Regent's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Moonveil Regent trigger, causing you to discard your hand, then mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Raven's Crime, causing target player to discard a card.
Repeat.

948-2060-2433-3062-3545.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
948-2060-2433-3062-3545.description:
Activate Ooze Flux by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Ooze creature token.
Rosie Cotton of South Lane triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Pir.
When the Ooze enters the battlefield, Sigil Captain triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on it due to Pir.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Oozes with a +1/+1 counter on them, you may remove those counters to create an infinitely large Ooze using Ooze Flux.

225-539-3318-5077.notablePrerequisites:
Scaretiller is untapped.
You have a basic land in library.
225-539-3318-5077.description:
Play Fabled Passage.
Fabled Passage enters the battlefield, triggering Stone-Seeder Hierophant, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping any land you control.
Activate Fabled Passage by tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to search your library for a basic land, put it onto the battlefield tapped, and then untap the land.
The basic land enters the battlefield, triggering Stone-Seeder Hierophant, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Scaretiller.
Activate Scaretiller by tapping it, adding {G}.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Fabled Passage from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.
